newDueDateOffsetSeconds.description: Offset in seconds for new due date. If you want to set the due date to 2 days from now set this to 172800 - (24 * 60 * 60 * 2)

requesterId.description: ID of the user who requested the work order through the Work Request feature

sequentialId.description: Organization specific ID of the work order

startDate.description: Date & time at which the work order will show up in the inboxOnly valid when dueDate is set

status.description: Note: It is also possible to register a webhook to get notified when the status of any work order changes. Please see the Subscriptions section for more information.

teamIds.description: List of team ids assigned to the work order

createdAt.description: Date & time at which the attachment was uploaded

height.description: Height if the file is an image

url.description: Url of the file. Valid for 60 minutes.

width.description: Width if the file is an image

type.description: Valid types of Work Orders, including options that are not available for creation/update. Historical Work Orders may have a null type.

updatedAt.description: Date & time at which the work order was last updated. This doesn't include comments

workOrderSummary.description: Work Order Summary. Null when no summary is available.

authorId.description: ID of the user who authored the completion note

description: Manage work orders, work requests, assets and locations, and look up teams and users.
